description.en: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）插件：把 ego-lite 浏览器（给 AI Agent 用的 Chromium）接入 HARNESS——13 个结构化 ego_* 工具（文本语义快照、语义定位点击、表单填充、截图、CDP 控制、任务空间隔离），内置 ego 运行时，Linux + Chrome 开箱即用，无需克隆官方仓库或手动构建。
description.zh: untranslated

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: the claude-data skill from baoyu-design. The agent builds data-backed dashboards as files and opens them in a local dashboard editor.

DeepSeek Harness plugin: the claude-whiteboard skill from baoyu-design. The agent lays out diagrams, flows, maps of ideas and plans on a whiteboard and opens it in a local board editor where you move, draw and comment.

A local ComfyUI workbench for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): image/audio/video generation, W2/W3 sprite cards with Qwen back-view walk-up, local Flux.2 Item Studio assets with guided SDXL fallback, Hugging Face downloads, inspection and arbitrary workflows.
**dsh-chat** — Bring a ChatGPT-like Chat & Agent experience to DeepSeek Harness, with seamless handoff to coding agents.
在 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 里直接用 YesNAI（公益站 nai.rinko.ai / 主站 ynai.rinko.ai）出图的插件：原生 rinko_nai_image 工具 + 设置页（登录/余额/活动/图包/充值/画廊/流水/法术解析）+ 对话框悬浮球。
SuperAgent PTC: long-task supervision for DeepSeek Harness - anchors, bounded delegation, independent reviewer, evidence-gated release
A DeepSeek Harness plugin for Assistant Web Owner.

DSH 同步插件 2.1.2：侧边栏四页（工作区同步 / 插件同步 / 技能同步 / 设置）。同步根下建本机特征文件夹（工作区 / 插件 / 技能三个子文件夹）。工作区：有标识文档或已注册即显示，开关一开就注册侧栏+建存档+自动备份对话，关闭即删存档与侧栏工作区；巡检自动补标识文档、拉取其他电脑的会话记录并自动补登记。插件：清单带来源渠道与 git 仓库地址；本地安装的插件会探测 package.json 里的上游 git 仓库，探测到就按 git 共享地址（别人可按仓库装），他人有本机没有的可一键联网安
Bounded, typed preference learning for the DSH personal assistant.

VibeDev 影视工作台：在 DeepSeek Harness 和 VibeDev 的右侧栏打开画布式影视工作台（剧本、分镜画布、图片/视频/音频生成、剪辑成片），模型与费用统一走 VibeDev 账号 · VibeDev Film: a canvas film workbench in the right sidebar of DeepSeek Harness and VibeDev (script, storyboard canvas, image/video/audio generation, e
dsh plugin: SYSTEM proxy (env) + LLM traffic-splitting proxy via a process-global undici routing dispatcher
description.zh: 把 LLM 请求按配置分流到指定代理，其余流量走系统代理，没配就直连。

description.en: Cortex workbench for DeepSeek Harness: the original Cortex UI (vulnerabilities, client findings, assets, internal operations, Memory Nebula, snapshots, retest, standalone Web Fuzzer with raw/JSON/render responses, mini-program reversing), project/selected
Full-text search over local session records: sidebar panel plus a Cmd+F find bar, hits open the session at the message. No model calls.
PocketAgents — Control Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Antigravity IDE, DeepSeek Harness & WorkBuddy from your phone. Self-hosted, swipe approvals, voice input & 5s terminal QR.
description.zh: PocketAgents（原 deepseekharness-remotecontrol）：DeepSeek Harness 的开源自托管手机端 Web PWA 与飞书远程总控台（同时支持本机 Antigravity IDE、Codex、Claude Code、WorkBuddy 与豆包），支持滑卡批阅审批、多选弹窗交互回复、微信式按住说话插话、回复语音播报、HLS/WebRTC 文件视频流预览、多主机置顶同步、锁屏 Web Push 推送与 5 秒终端二维码免密配对。

description.en: Agent Skills · 𝓲-Collection
description.zh: 把可复用的 Agent 技能打包成插件，装完就能给 AI 助手加各种现成任务能力

description.en: A visual decision workbench for DeepSeek Harness: explore ideas, focus branches, and turn choices into executable graphs.
Mobile device capability plugin for DeepSeek Harness: MobileService seam, mock/mobile-mcp providers, agent tools (observe/open_app/tap/type/back), tiered execution policy
DSH 扫榜插件：多站小说榜单采集 + 本地变化分析 + 面板；零运行时依赖
description.zh: 定时或手动抓取多个小说站的公开榜单，自动比对排名变化，在一个面板里挑着看。

description.en: Delegate subtasks from DeepSeek Harness to Herdr-managed coding agents, harvest exact results, and review them in DSH.
description.zh: 把 DSH 里的子任务派给 Herdr 管理的编码代理，拿回准确结果并在 DSH 里直接审阅。

description.en: Bundles the Aesthetics-OS aesthetic-judgment skill as a runtime skill with a red-line routing section, plus 22 native tools backed by bundled Python scripts: a persistent propose→brief→evidence→measure→critique→verdict state machine that refuses unverified passes, a delivery gate, fingerprint-based reskin detection, and Euler color/texture/structure lenses. State machine needs only Python 3 stdlib; lenses need numpy+Pillow.
description.zh: 把 Aesthetics-OS 审美判断技能注册为运行时技能并注入红线路由段，另提供 22 个由包内 Python 脚本驱动的原生工具：持久化 命题→简报→证据→测量→审判→结论 状态机（拒绝无证据通过）、交付门禁、形式指纹抓换皮、欧拉色彩/纹理/结构透镜。状态机仅需 Python 3 标准库；透镜需 numpy+Pillow。

description.en: Shows the signed-in account's top-up and bonus balance above the DSH sidebar account entry, refreshed every minute with a manual refresh button.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏底部账号入口上方显示当前登录账号的充值余额与赠金余额，每分钟自动刷新，并可手动刷新。

description.en: A DSH appearance plugin offering wallpaper, glassmorphism, palette theming, and a sidebar usage widget. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供壁纸、玻璃拟态、图片取色主题以及侧栏用量小组件的外观插件。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Static architecture maps for Python: one command turns a repository into a self-contained, drillable HTML - project overview, execution flow, module surface, method source and callers - without running the code or fetching anything.
description.zh: 把 Python 仓库变成可逐层下钻的架构图：一个命令生成自包含 HTML，从项目结构与执行流下钻到模块能力面、方法源码和调用者，不运行被测代码、不联网。

description.en: Antigravity-style /btw side questions for DSH: during a task, one question starts a disposable forked child agent with the full tool set, answers in its own right-Sidebar tab (tool calls and permission prompts included), and leaves the main conversation and its model context untouched.
description.zh: DSH 的 Antigravity 风格 /btw 侧问：任务进行中问一句，由一个临时 fork 的子 agent 带着完整工具在右侧栏自己的页签里作答（工具调用与审批都在那里），主对话与模型上下文完全不受影响。

description.en: Adds a long-running DSH project mode with a user-confirmed start, scoped executor sessions, source checks, independent review, and a task ledger for resuming work.
description.zh: 为 DSH 添加长任务模式，用户确认开工后按文件授权派发子会话，分两道审核核对成果与出处，并用任务账本接续工作。

description.en: Explains DeepSeek prompt cache misses in a right-sidebar tab. It observes system-prompt/assemble and llm/stream, compares each request with the previous one in the same session, and names the first part that changed: a system prompt section (shown before and after, with the changed characters marked), the tool list, rewritten history, an expired cache or compaction. Shows today's hit rate, money the cache saved, avoidable extra cost at DeepSeek's peak and off-peak list prices, the last requests and seven days of totals.
description.zh: 在右侧栏解释 DeepSeek 提示词缓存为什么没命中：旁观 system-prompt/assemble 和 llm/stream，把每次请求和同一会话的上一次逐段比较，指出第一个变化的地方：系统提示词的哪一段（前后内容并排，标出变了的字）、工具列表、被改写的历史、缓存过期或上下文压缩。显示今日命中率、缓存省下的钱、按 DeepSeek 峰谷价算出的可避免花费、最近的请求和近 7 天统计。

description.en: A separate chat area for DeepSeek Harness: a sidebar panel and a phone-installable PWA over the same conversations, with a self-managed history library (day grouping, full-text search), attachments inline, and host-side text extraction for PDF, DOCX, PPTX and XLSX so the model needs no file tools. Conversations live in their own directory, not in a coding workspace. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: DSH 的独立闲聊区：侧栏面板与可装到手机的 PWA 共用同一批会话，自带历史库（按天分组、全文搜索）、附件内联，并在宿主侧抽取 PDF/DOCX/PPTX/XLSX 文字，模型不需要任何文件工具。会话放在专属目录，不混进写代码的工作区。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Adds the Design closure agent preset and the chip-design skill for digital chip front-end work: architecture budgets, design specs, functional and acceptance point lists, RTL, timing closure and PPA. Ships three scripts — a 38-rule spec linter, a Markdown to docx/PDF converter, and a draw.io / Mermaid / WaveDrom figure renderer.
description.zh: 增加「设计收口」代理预设与 chip-design 技能，覆盖架构预算、设计规格、功能点与验收点清单、RTL、时序收口与 PPA。附带三个脚本：38 条规则的规格校验、Markdown 转 docx/PDF、draw.io / Mermaid / WaveDrom 出图。

description.en: Runs the daily check-in for Kuro Games (Wuthering Waves, Punishing Gray Raven), Skland (Arknights, Endfield) and NTE, then pushes the result to QQ. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 每天自动签到库街区（鸣潮/战双）、森空岛（明日方舟/终末地）和塔吉多（异环），签完可把结果推到 QQ。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Queues questions written in the composer and sends them only while DeepSeek bills at off-peak rates. Delivery is driven by a 30-second clock check rather than a pre-scheduled trigger, so a question missed while the app was closed is not released into the peak window. Up to 50 queued items, localStorage persistence, retry with exponential backoff, and a send-now button that pays the peak price.
description.zh: 把输入框里的问题排进队列，只在 DeepSeek 低谷计价时段（半价）发出。投递由每 30 秒一次的时钟检查驱动，而不是预先排定触发时间，因此应用关闭期间错过的问题不会被补投进高峰。最多 50 条、localStorage 持久化、失败指数退避重试，也可按高峰价立即发送。

description.en: Feishu sign-in provider for Doubao Work enterprise models in DSH, with streaming text, account switching, usage details and optional task archiving.
description.zh: 通过飞书账号在 DSH 中使用豆包工作的企业订阅模型，支持流式文本、账号切换、用量明细与可选任务归档。

description.en: Puts a 3D room inside DSH: chat from inside the room, farm the yard, keep fish, and collect a gacha card album. The room runtime itself is a separate download. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 把「大肥鱼的小日子」那个 3D 房间接进 DSH：屋里能打字聊天，院子里能种地养鱼，还有抽卡和卡册。房间本体单独下载。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Collects DSH sessions into categorized favorites in a sidebar panel, with stars on the session header and every row, a default category, multi-select custom categories, and filtering by category.
description.zh: 把 DSH 会话分类型收藏到左侧「重要会话」面板，会话标题和每一行都有星标，收藏默认放进「默认收藏夹」，可多选自定义分类并按分类筛选。

description.en: Jev judgments inside DeepSeek Harness: prune oversized tool output, screen fetched pages, suggest skills, plus explicit ask/gate tools and a persistent local ledger.
description.zh: 把 Jev 判定模型接进 DeepSeek Harness：精简超长工具输出、筛查抓取页面、推荐技能，另带显式 ask/gate 判定工具与本地累计台账。

description.en: A Feishu/Lark workbench for DeepSeek Harness: build a Base from one sentence and operate calendar, tasks, chat, mail, and contacts from the sidebar. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 飞书智能工作台：一句话生成多维表格，并在侧栏处理日程、待办、群聊、邮件与通讯录。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Dynamic wallpaper with a six-zone glass skin. A Host-side gallery aggregates five online video sources (Mixkit, MoeWalls, MotionBgs, WallpaperWaifu, LiveWallpapers4Free) with category filters, English keyword search, paging and favourites; local MP4/WebM/GIF/images up to 256 MB are imported by chunked upload without transcoding, and three canvas scenes work offline. The sidebar, content area, composer, usage bar, command menu and sent message bubbles each take their own colour, 0–100% opacity and backdrop blur of up to 30px. Playback pauses while the window is hidden or the system asks for reduced motion, and can also pause while an agent is working — signalled from the Host over SSE rather than by polling the DOM. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 动态壁纸 + 六区毛玻璃皮肤。Host 侧图库聚合五家在线视频源（Mixkit、MoeWalls、MotionBgs、WallpaperWaifu、LiveWallpapers4Free），支持分类筛选、英文关键词搜索、分页与收藏；本地 MP4/WebM/GIF/图片上限 256 MB，分片上传、不转码，另有三款离线 Canvas 场景。左侧栏、内容区、输入框、用量栏、指令菜单与你发送的气泡各自拥有底色、0–100% 遮罩和最高 30px 的毛玻璃模糊。窗口不可见或系统要求减少动态效果时暂停播放，也可在模型执行任务期间暂停——该信号由 Host 通过 SSE 下发，不靠轮询 DOM。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Pins reasoning effort to the highest level every model offers, and keeps it pinned for agents created after the plugin loads.
description.zh: 把每个模型的推理档位钉在它支持的最高档，并且对插件加载后新建的 agent 继续生效。

description.en: Run an APK in a managed Android emulator inside DeepSeek Harness: upload it, mirror the screen, drive it with mouse and keyboard, and inspect decrypted HTTPS requests like DevTools. Needs Windows with hardware virtualization, JDK 17+, Python 3.10+, and about 5 GB for the first Android SDK install. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 在 DSH 页面里托管安卓模拟器运行 APK：上传安装、实时投屏、用鼠标和电脑键盘操作，并像 DevTools 一样查看解密后的 HTTPS 请求。需要 Windows + 硬件虚拟化、JDK 17+、Python 3.10+，首次安装 Android SDK 约 5GB。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: DSH Movies workbench : Search for movies and TV series from TMDB, IMDb and Douban on one page and automatically discover BT resources. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: DSH 影视工作台：在一个页面里检索 TMDB、IMDb 和 豆瓣 的电影与剧集，自动发现 BT 资源。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Queue non-urgent tasks during the day in a right-sidebar tab, run them automatically in fresh sessions during DeepSeek's off-peak half-price window (configurable Beijing start time outside weekday peak hours, serial or bounded concurrency), and read a morning report with per-task status, changed files, commands run, token cost, savings versus peak hours, and steps skipped because they required user approval.
description.zh: 在右侧栏提供「夜班鲸」面板：白天把不急的任务（指令与工作区/目录）加入夜班清单，到 DeepSeek 空闲半价时段（可配北京时间开始时间，自动避开工作日高峰双倍价，支持串行或限并发）自动为每个任务开新会话执行，次日给出晨报卡片，汇总完成/失败/卡住状态、改动文件、执行命令、token 与费用、相比高峰省下的钱，以及无人值守时因需人工确认而未执行的步骤。

description.en: Lists every Our Free Model (EAC router) channel you are signed in to, with its remaining credit, at the bottom of the DSH sidebar; the channel behind your current model is highlighted and balances refresh live. Requires dsh-our-free-model with at least one channel signed in.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏底部列出你在 Our Free Model（EAC router）中已登录的每个渠道及其剩余 credit，当前模型所属渠道高亮显示，余额实时刷新。需先安装 dsh-our-free-model 并登录至少一个渠道。

description.en: OpenID Connect sign-in for the DSH Web UI with any provider, either behind a reverse proxy (forward auth in Caddy, nginx or Traefik) or as its own gateway in front of DSH. Admits several people by subject, verified email, group or claim, lists and revokes signed-in sessions in Settings, and can keep sessions across restarts. Maintained fork of Senti100/dsh-oidc.
description.zh: 为 DSH 网页端提供 OpenID Connect 登录，可接任意身份提供方，既能放在反向代理后（Caddy、nginx、Traefik 的 forward auth），也能作为 DSH 前面的独立网关。可按 subject、已验证邮箱、分组或声明放行多人，在设置里查看并撤销已登录会话，并可在重启后保留会话。是 Senti100/dsh-oidc 的维护分支。

description.en: Chibi desk-pet pack for `dsh-pet`: ships 16 AI-model personas, each with 17 transparent 24 fps VP9 WebM animations (272 clips total), 4 reaction PNG stickers (64 total), an avatar and a preset config. On enable, syncs the selected `pets` roster (`all`, `wave1`, `wave2` or a comma-separated list) into `$DSH_HOME/dsh-pet/pet/` (fetching four SHA-512-verified `@linyucion/dsh-pet-ai-sisters-pack-*` tarballs from npmmirror / npmjs in the background when installed from the lightweight npm bundle) with a `.ai-sisters-manifest.json` version stamp while preserving user-modified `display`, `size`, `position` and toggle fields in `<id>-config.json`, then calls `/dsh-pet-7340/reload`. Registers five right-click menu actions via `/dsh-pet-7340/menu/item` — foreground-window top perch (Win32 `GetForegroundWindow` bounds on Windows, fixed fallback elsewhere), two-pet paired-line skit, folder peek, screen-glass knock and cloud nap — and unregisters them when disabled.
description.zh: 面向 `dsh-pet` 的 Q 版桌宠扩展包：内置 16 位 AI 模型拟人角色，每位含 17 段 24fps VP9 透明通道 WebM 动画（共 272 段）、4 张表情贴纸（共 64 张）、头像与预设配置。启用时按 `pets` 配置（`all`、`wave1`、`wave2` 或逗号分隔列表）同步至 `$DSH_HOME/dsh-pet/pet/`（从轻量 npm 包安装时后台拉取并校验四个 SHA-512 固化的 `@linyucion/dsh-pet-ai-sisters-pack-*` 媒体分包）并写入 `.ai-sisters-manifest.json` 版本戳，升级时保留 `<id>-config.json` 中已修改的显示、尺寸、坐标与开关项，随后调用 `/dsh-pet-7340/reload` 热重载；同时经 `/dsh-pet-7340/menu/item` 挂载五项右键互动菜单（前台窗口顶晃脚、双人台词小剧场、文件夹探头、敲屏幕玻璃、抱云朵小憩），停用时自动注销。

description.en: Turns your agent's day or week into a shareable 1080x1632 retro pixel-art battle report card in a right-sidebar tab. Passively observes llm/stream, tools/result, session/event and workspace/changes to render real files and lines changed, commands run, sessions and turns, estimated DeepSeek cost and cache savings, a 24-hour (or 7-day) pixel bar chart, a pixel whale mascot, and a deterministic RPG rank title. Includes three color themes (DeepSea, GameBoy, Arcade), a privacy toggle to hide file and workspace names, PNG download and clipboard copy.
description.zh: 在右侧栏把 Agent 今天或本周的活做成一张 1080×1632 复古像素风战报卡片：旁观 llm/stream、tools/result、session/event 和 workspace/changes，真实统计改动文件与增删行数、执行命令、会话与轮次、按 DeepSeek 峰谷价估算的花费与缓存省钱、24 小时（或近 7 天）像素活跃柱状图、像素鲸角色以及确定性 RPG 评级称号。内置深海、掌机、街机三套配色，支持一键隐藏文件名、下载 PNG 和复制图片分享。

description.en: Reads instant-message chats through an allowlist and turns them into local files and digests: Telegram fetched from the server, WhatsApp from official export files or WhatsApp Web. The agent can only file an approval request; a per-chat policy store gates every read, and the digest keeps quotes verified verbatim against the source apart from model-written summaries. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 按白名单读取即时消息并落成本地文件与摘要：Telegram 从服务器拉取，WhatsApp 走官方导出文件或 WhatsApp Web。批准只能由人做，Agent 只能登记请求；每个会话过策略库才放行，摘要把「原文照抄（逐句回查）」与「模型生成」分开写。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Gives the agent your browser login state only for domains you approve: a Chromium/Firefox extension filters cookies to the approved list before they leave the browser, a token-gated 127.0.0.1 receiver keeps them in Host memory, and a disposable read-only browser opens pages, follows links and extracts PDF text with form submission and every non-GET request blocked. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 只把你批准的域名的浏览器登录态交给智能体：Chromium/Firefox 扩展在 cookie 离开浏览器前按白名单过滤，带配对令牌的 127.0.0.1 接收器把它们只留在宿主内存里，一次性的只读浏览器可以打开页面、跟随链接、抽取 PDF 文字，表单提交与所有非 GET 请求都被拦截。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: ReadingOS for DeepSeek Harness: access Apple Books highlights on macOS with a heatmap, theme-based passages, markdown export, and a bridge to chat directly with DeepSeek. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 专属 ReadingOS：读取 macOS 苹果图书划线与批注，提供年阅读足迹热力图、跨书主题对照、Markdown 导出以及一键直通 DeepSeek 展开研读探讨。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: A separate agent mode for DeepSeek Harness: reasoning goes into a sandbox document, every action is written there first and then executed by reading it back, and the final answer is printed from that document. Direct tool calls are blocked per preset, and the output also lands as a file card. Deliberately more expensive, and the mode picker says so.
description.zh: DSH 的一个独立 agent 模式（preset）：推理写进沙盒文档，每个动作先写进文档再读回来执行，最终输出也从文档发出。按 preset 拦截其它工具直调，输出同时落成文件卡片。设计上更费 token，模式选择器里已注明。

description.en: A side-panel Texas Hold'em table with three fixed-style AI opponents and a live equity, odds and range coach. Runs locally; no network or account.
description.zh: DSH 右侧浮动德州扑克牌桌，三位固定风格 AI 对手与实时胜率、赔率、范围教练。完全本地运行，无需联网或账号。

description.en: Cost-basis workbench for your own positions: log buys/sells, then preview how a trade would change cost, position size and break-even before you place it. Local-only, no quotes, no network.
description.zh: 持仓成本台：记录自己的买卖，并在下单前预览这笔交易会把成本、仓位、保本价变成多少。只在本机读写，不含行情、不联网。

description.en: Prompt presets in the composer tool row: pick one and it is inserted at the caret with focus returned to the input. Rows can be edited in place, added, deleted with undo, and reordered by drag.
description.zh: 输入框工具行的快捷提示词：选中一条即插入到光标处并把焦点交回输入框，可直接回车发送。支持就地编辑、新增、带撤销的删除、拖拽排序。

description.en: Adds ordered colour strips and step counts to native DSH Web activity summaries without changing messages or folding.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 原生活动汇总添加按执行顺序排列的彩虹条和分类计数，不改变消息或折叠行为。

description.en: Enhances DSH memory plugins by reconstructing retrieved memory fragments into contextual, emotionally-toned recollections with an LLM before injection, instead of quoting raw text; read-only to the underlying memory store, with multi-source support, per-user IM isolation, sleep consolidation and a JSONL audit log.
description.zh: 增强 DSH 记忆插件：把检索到的记忆碎片经 LLM 重建为带语境与情绪的回忆片段再注入，而非念原文；对底层记忆库只读，支持多记忆源、IM 用户级隔离、睡眠巩固与 JSONL 审计日志。

description.en: SSH remote hosts for DeepSeek Harness: pick a host from ~/.ssh/config, keep a local forward alive, and open its DSH web UI in the browser.
description.zh: 从 ~/.ssh/config 选择主机，保持 SSH 本地转发，在浏览器打开远端 DSH Web 界面。

description.en: Pre-flight resource gate for tool calls: estimates peak memory and VRAM from the command line, the scripts it references and per-binary costs, compares that with the machine live headroom and allows, asks or refuses; a budget block in the system prompt lets the model size concurrency, a runtime breaker warns when a call crosses the line, and measured peaks feed back into later estimates. Windows only. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 工具调用的事前资源门禁：从命令行、它引用的脚本内容与按二进制的单价估算峰值内存与显存，与机器当前余量比较后放行、询问或拒绝；系统提示里注入实时预算让模型自己定并发，运行时熔断在越线时告警，实测峰值回填到后续估算。仅支持 Windows。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: SCP upload and download over the legacy wire protocol on an ssh2 exec channel — works against servers and network devices without an SFTP subsystem, with named auth profiles, recursive trees and remote glob-batch downloads.
description.zh: 通过 ssh2 exec 通道实现传统 SCP 协议的文件上传与下载，适用于未开启 SFTP 子系统的服务器与网络设备；支持命名认证配置、递归目录与远端通配符批量下载。

description.en: Import Codex, Claude Code / Claude Desktop and WorkBuddy conversations as DSH sessions, scoped by time range and project, with an optional message cap and four detail levels from prose-only to complete tool output.
description.zh: 把 Codex、Claude Code / Claude Desktop 与 WorkBuddy 的会话导入为 DSH 会话，可按时间范围与项目筛选，可选消息条数上限，并提供从仅正文到完整工具输出的四档详细程度。

description.en: Bundles a skill that turns local WeChat 4.x chat history into plaintext SQLite. It reads each database key out of the running WeChat process memory (the Config.Cipher path, no brute force and no third-party binary), verifies every key against the page HMAC, then decrypts page by page with the Windows CNG AES implementation, leaving SQLite files you can query with any tool. Key extraction and decryption are read-only and nothing leaves the machine; the skill also offers an optional export to JSONL and CSV that strips XML from message bodies and can exclude group chats. Requirements are Python 3 on Windows with the WeChat desktop client running and logged in, plus Node.js 22.15 or newer for the optional export.
description.zh: 打包一个技能，把本地微信 4.x 聊天记录导出成明文 SQLite：从运行中的微信进程内存里按 Config.Cipher 路径取每个库的密钥（不暴力枚举、不依赖第三方二进制），用页尾 HMAC 校验密钥，再用 Windows CNG 的 AES 逐页解密，得到任何工具都能打开的 SQLite 文件。取密钥与解密全程只读，数据不出本机；技能还可选导出 JSONL 与 CSV，自动去掉消息体里的 XML 标签，并支持排除群聊。前提是 Windows 上装有 Python 3、微信客户端正在运行且已登录，可选导出另需 Node.js 22.15 及以上。

description.en: Per-session and global exposure gate for skills and MCP tools — checkbox toggles in a sidebar panel and a settings page; denied items are removed from the model's tool/skill catalog on the next message, with batch apply, draft diff preview and per-session persistence. Needs DSH 0.2.0+.
description.zh: 按会话与全局管控 skill 与 MCP 工具的暴露集——在侧栏面板与设置页勾选，停用项在下一条消息从模型目录移除；支持批量应用、草稿差异预览与会话级持久化。需 DSH 0.2.0+。

description.en: Adds a countdown entry to the DSH sidebar footer whose panel shows the days to Chinese New Year's Eve and New Year's Day as split-flap cards that flip like an airport board, next to the current date and time, progress through the ongoing Spring Festival cycle and the day index of the holiday, and registers a spring_festival_countdown tool so the model can answer when the holiday starts.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏底部新增「倒计时」入口，面板用翻板牌显示距除夕与正月初一的天数（秒位每秒真翻一次），旁边是当前年月日时分秒、本轮春节进度与假期第几天，另注册 spring_festival_countdown 工具让模型能回答「还有多久过年」。

description.en: A desk cat that counts down to clock-off and nudges you to stand up, with break mode, chime and background notifications.
description.zh: 工位小猫：下班倒计时与久坐起身提醒，支持休息模式、提示音和后台通知。

description.en: Chinese add-on fork of the dsh-think-flow sidebar chain-of-thought panel: while upstream folds each session's live reasoning into turn → step groups, this fork sends each step to a separate, configurable model (titleProvider/titleModel) and shows an 8–18 character Chinese title plus a 20–60 character Chinese explanation under every step, and a one-line Chinese title per turn. The main model is untouched — no system-prompt injection, no extra tools, no context changes; the plug-in just makes its own request. autoTitlesOn arms title generation as soon as a panel connects, and batches over 10 steps are split so long turns (100+ steps) no longer come back empty; steps that only call a tool (no reasoning) are summarised from the call itself, and a failed segment is retried up to three times with backoff.
description.zh: dsh-think-flow 侧栏思维链面板的中文增强 fork：上游把每个会话的实时思考折成 turn → step 分组；本 fork 再把每一步交给另一个可配置的模型（titleProvider/titleModel），在步骤行下面写一行 8~18 字中文标题与 20~60 字中文解释，整轮写一条中文标题。主模型完全不动——不注入系统提示词、不新增工具、不改上下文，插件只是自己多发一次请求。autoTitlesOn 让面板一连上就自动补标题；超过 10 步的批次会切段生成，100+ 步的长轮也不会整批返回空；只调工具、没有思考的步骤按工具调用本身给解读，某段失败会退避重试最多三次。

description.en: Question-first DSH composer review that asks up to two evidence-backed questions without rewriting the draft.
description.zh: 只提问、不代写的 DSH 输入框表达审查，最多给出两个带原文依据的问题。

description.en: Peak-hour batch queue: lines entered on a settings page are held during DeepSeek peak pricing and, once off-peak starts, each line is dispatched as its own task — to a new session or to an existing session picked per line. Entries stay editable and removable until sent.
description.zh: 峰价批量待办队列：在设置页按行录入任务，峰价时段只存不发；进入谷时后每条各自派发执行——可开新会话，也可逐条指定已有会话。未派发前可编辑、删除。

description.en: Toutiao hot-list and keyword-search collector for DeepSeek Harness. Fetches the 50-item hot board, runs keyword searches, and pulls full article text over plain HTTP without login or request signing. Exposes five model tools (toutiao_hot, toutiao_search, toutiao_article, toutiao_digest, toutiao_draft), provides a toutiao Cordis service other plugins can call, and adds a settings panel card with configurable limits and keywords, a scheduled fetch, and an optional draft writer that uses the host model to turn search results into a publishable article. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 今日头条热榜与关键词搜索采集插件。免登录、免签名，用纯 HTTP 抓取 50 条热榜、做关键词搜索、并抓取文章全文。提供五个模型工具（toutiao_hot、toutiao_search、toutiao_article、toutiao_digest、toutiao_draft），通过 toutiao 服务供其他插件调用，并在设置面板提供可配置条数与关键词、定时抓取，以及可选地调用宿主模型把搜索结果写成一篇可发布文章的草稿功能。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Checks npm for a newer @deepseek-ai/dsh and shows it under the composer. On Windows, one click runs a self-check (powershell, npm, a dry run of the updater script, and a plugin compatibility gate against the target core), then stops DSH, backs up the core manifests, installs the release, upgrades the plugins that need a newer release for that core — a plugin that only supports the new core cannot be installed while the old core is still running, so both happen in the window where DSH is down — and restarts DSH; if a step fails it rolls back to the previous version and starts that. The update runs with a per-step progress bar, real steps while the host is alive and the steps the updater script recorded on disk after the restart. Also registers the dsh_check_update and dsh_update_doctor tools.
description.zh: 检查 npm 上是否有更新的 @deepseek-ai/dsh，结果显示在输入框下方。在 Windows 上点一下会先自检（powershell、npm、更新脚本试跑、插件兼容闸门），再停止 DSH、备份核心树清单、安装新版本、把需要新核心的插件一并升级——只认新核心的插件在旧核心还跑着的时候装不上，所以两件事都放在 DSH 停着的那段窗口里——最后重启 DSH；任一步失败都会回滚到旧版本并把它启动起来。更新过程有分步进度条，宿主存活时是真实步骤，重启后读回更新脚本写在磁盘上的步骤记录。另提供 dsh_check_update 与 dsh_update_doctor 工具。

description.en: Local-first video screening: ffmpeg samples frames, local Qwen3-ASR writes timecoded subtitles, a local vision model captions and ranks sampled frames, and a local text model folds the transcript into chapters; the original candidate frames are then handed to the leading model. Every stage resumes from the workspace, and export writes SRT, a timeline and native-resolution key frames.
description.zh: 本地优先的视频初筛：ffmpeg 抽帧，本地 Qwen3-ASR 出带时间码的字幕，本地视觉模型给抽样帧写描述并打分，本地文本模型把转写折成章节，最后把原始候选帧交给主模型判断。每一级都能从工作区断点续跑，导出 SRT、时间线与原生分辨率的候选帧。

description.en: Offline vocabulary flashcards, multiple-choice practice, and vocabulary assessment in a draggable DSH Web overlay with locally stored progress.
description.zh: 在可拖动的 DSH Web 浮层中离线刷词、进行四选一练习和词汇量测评，学习进度保存在本地。

description.en: DSH WeChat Channel: connect a personal WeChat bot to the local DeepSeek Harness and drive local agents from WeChat. Derived from MichengAI/dsh-im-connect (Apache-2.0) with the other IM channels removed， customed UI desiging and identifiers renamed so both can be installed side by side.
description.zh: DSH微信频道：把个人微信机器人接入本机 DeepSeek Harness，在微信里随时驱动本机智能体。基于 MichengAI/dsh-im-connect（Apache-2.0）改造，删去其它 IM 通道、定制化界面开发并重命名标识，因此可与上游同装。

description.en: A 176×50 pixel room in the right sidebar that keeps an eye on your agent: the monitor types while a session runs, a sign flashes amber and the cat sits up when one waits for your approval, a green light means new results and red means the last turn failed, with an optional chime. Its WebGL2 glass knob switches the room between day, dusk and night and, through tools/pre-execute, sets how often the agent asks before acting (ask every step, normal, hands-off); git push, publish and sudo ask in every level.
description.zh: 右侧栏里一间会看 Agent 脸色的 176×50 像素小书房：会话在跑时显示器敲代码，等你确认时灯牌闪黄、猫坐起来，跑完亮绿灯，出错变红，可开提示音。WebGL2 玻璃旋钮把房间拨到白天、黄昏或深夜，同时通过 tools/pre-execute 决定 Agent 改文件、跑命令、装依赖前要不要先问你（每步确认、常规、放手跑）；git push、发布、sudo 在任何一档都要确认。

description.en: Xiaohongshu (RED) note collector for DeepSeek Harness. Drives a dedicated browser instance through CDP and reads the responses the site itself produces, so it works with the user logged in through the normal browser instead of reproducing the request signing. Searches notes by keyword, opens note detail (body text, images, tags), and reads comments. Exposes five model tools (xhs_search, xhs_note, xhs_draft, xhs_login, xhs_status), provides an xhs Cordis service, and adds a settings panel card for login, search and an optional draft writer that uses the host model to compose a publishable note from search results. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 小红书笔记采集插件。通过 CDP 驱动一个专用浏览器实例，监听网站自身发出的请求响应，因此只需在浏览器里正常登录即可工作，无需复现请求签名。支持按关键词搜索笔记、打开笔记详情（正文、图片、标签）以及读取评论。提供五个模型工具（xhs_search、xhs_note、xhs_draft、xhs_login、xhs_status），通过 xhs 服务供其他插件调用，并在设置面板提供登录、搜索，以及可选地调用宿主模型把搜索结果写成一篇可发布笔记的草稿功能。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Shows Windows desktop notifications for DeepSeek Harness task completion or failure, pending approvals or questions, and recognized quota or sign-in errors.
description.zh: 为 Windows 上的 DeepSeek Harness 提供任务完成或失败、等待授权或回答，以及可识别的额度或登录错误提醒。

description.en: Run local games natively inside the DeepSeek Harness panel: owned-window embedding with viewport sizing, no extra taskbar window, one UAC prompt for admin games. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 把本机游戏收进 DeepSeek Harness 面板里原生运行：窗口按视口尺寸摆放、不占任务栏、管理员游戏只需确认一次。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Zi Wei Dou Shu workbench: manage birth profiles, cast charts with iztro, browse horoscope history, and save AI readings.
description.zh: 紫微斗数工作台：管理生辰档案、用 iztro 排盘、查看运限历史并回填 AI 解读。

description.en: An on-demand HPC design and review skill covering numerical contracts, cost models, data movement, binding time, dependencies and engineering tradeoffs, with separately scoped source examples.
description.zh: 按需加载的 HPC 设计与评审技能，涵盖数值契约、成本模型、数据运动、绑定时机、并发依赖与工程取舍，源码案例独立于通用原则。

description.en: Fork of liustack/modsearch: a web-search bridge for text-only agents that adds MiniMax engines and a Zhipu engine (coding-plan MCP or balance REST, one engine with a channel setting) to a parallel multi-engine chain with per-engine failover, health lights and a Plugins-page settings card. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: liustack/modsearch 的分支：为纯文本模型的 agent 桥接网页搜索，在并行多引擎链上新增 MiniMax 引擎与智谱引擎（编程套餐 MCP 或余额 REST，一个引擎用通道设置切换），带逐引擎故障转移、健康状态灯与插件页设置卡片。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Adds a four-round review of an engineering or applied-mathematics paper to a DeepSeek Harness session: academic review, line-by-line verification of the maths and theorem proofs, English editing that returns both the original and the revised sentence, and a final pass over the revision against the baseline. Reads multi-file LaTeX projects, DOCX and PDF; every finding keeps a stable ID with its severity, evidence and handling status, and the rounds can run alone or as the full sequence.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 会话里对工程与应用数学论文做四轮审查：学术审查、逐式复核数学推导与定理证明、逐句英文编辑并同时给出原句与改句、以及对照基准稿的修订稿终审。可读多文件 LaTeX 工程、DOCX 与 PDF；每条问题保留稳定编号，并记录严重程度、证据与处理状态；四轮可以单独执行，也可以走完整流程。

description.en: Shows a Kegel break reminder at the end of a DSH headless turn after a successful Git commit or push.
description.zh: DSH headless 回合结束时，若 Git 提交或推送成功，则显示提肛运动提醒。

description.en: Adds a project center and a dockview workspace to the DSH web UI, arranging the main conversation, project preview, parallel free-model explorers and a shared board side by side, with sidebar notifications, notification sounds and auto-continue.
description.zh: 给 DSH Web 界面加上「项目中心」与「工作台」：用 dockview 把主对话、项目预览、并行免费模型探索者与共享黑板同屏编排，并配齐侧边栏呼吸灯角标、提示音与自动继续。

description.en: Database workbench for DeepSeek Harness: connection dropdown, object tree, data/schema/SQL tabs, read-only-first sql_* tools for SQLite, PostgreSQL and MySQL.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 数据库工作台：连接下拉、对象树、数据/结构/SQL 页签，只读优先的 sql_* 工具，支持 SQLite/PostgreSQL/MySQL。

description.en: [FROZEN 2026-10-31] Freight ratecard versioning, carrier bill audit, recovery summary and variance export.
description.zh: 管理运费费率版本、审核承运商账单，并汇总差异与追回金额。

description.en: Man！花了这么多钱！— DSH 每轮费用提醒，二十句离线语音随机播报，科比冰红茶探头。
description.zh: 每轮结束用科比冰红茶语音报出花费或 Token 用量，离线随机播报，提醒你别花太多钱。

description.en: Mermaid diagrams for DeepSeek Harness — on-demand rendering, compact ELK layout by default, theme-aware, copy and fullscreen zoom viewer
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里按需渲染 Mermaid 图表，默认紧凑 ELK 布局，支持主题适配、复制和全屏缩放查看。
